questions.questionText: Choose the one word that can replace the phrase: "An abnormal fear of confined or closed spaces"
questions.explanation: The word is "claustrophobia": abnormal fear of confined or closed spaces. The other options mean: agoraphobia: abnormal fear of open or crowded public places; acrophobia: abnormal fear of heights; hydrophobia: abnormal fear of water.

questions.questionText: Select the single word that best substitutes for: "An abnormal fear of open or crowded public places"
questions.explanation: The word is "agoraphobia": abnormal fear of open or crowded public places. The other options mean: claustrophobia: abnormal fear of confined or closed spaces; xenophobia: fear or hatred of strangers and foreigners; acrophobia: abnormal fear of heights.

questions.questionText: Which one word stands for "An abnormal fear of heights"?
questions.explanation: The word is "acrophobia": abnormal fear of heights. The other options mean: hydrophobia: abnormal fear of water; claustrophobia: abnormal fear of confined or closed spaces; photophobia: abnormal dread of, or sensitivity to, light.

questions.questionText: What is the one-word substitute for: "An abnormal fear of water"?
questions.explanation: The word is "hydrophobia": abnormal fear of water. The other options mean: acrophobia: abnormal fear of heights; pyrophobia: abnormal fear of fire; xenophobia: fear or hatred of strangers and foreigners.

questions.questionText: Choose the one word that can replace the phrase: "A fear or hatred of strangers and foreigners"
questions.explanation: The word is "xenophobia": fear or hatred of strangers and foreigners. The other options mean: technophobia: fear or dislike of advanced technology; agoraphobia: abnormal fear of open or crowded public places; hydrophobia: abnormal fear of water.

questions.questionText: Select the single word that best substitutes for: "An abnormal dread of, or sensitivity to, light"
questions.explanation: The word is "photophobia": abnormal dread of, or sensitivity to, light. The other options mean: nyctophobia: abnormal fear of darkness or night; claustrophobia: abnormal fear of confined or closed spaces; acrophobia: abnormal fear of heights.

questions.questionText: Which one word stands for "An abnormal fear of fire"?

questions.questionText: What is the one-word substitute for: "An abnormal fear of spiders"?
questions.explanation: The word is "arachnophobia": abnormal fear of spiders. The other options mean: ophidiophobia: abnormal fear of snakes; cynophobia: abnormal fear of dogs; ailurophobia: abnormal fear of cats.

questions.questionText: Choose the one word that can replace the phrase: "An abnormal fear of dogs"
questions.explanation: The word is "cynophobia": abnormal fear of dogs. The other options mean: ailurophobia: abnormal fear of cats; arachnophobia: abnormal fear of spiders; ophidiophobia: abnormal fear of snakes.

questions.questionText: Select the single word that best substitutes for: "An abnormal fear of blood"
questions.explanation: The word is "haemophobia": abnormal fear of blood. The other options mean: hydrophobia: abnormal fear of water; pyrophobia: abnormal fear of fire; technophobia: fear or dislike of advanced technology.

questions.questionText: Which one word stands for "A fear or dislike of advanced technology and machines"?
questions.explanation: The word is "technophobia": fear or dislike of advanced technology. The other options mean: xenophobia: fear or hatred of strangers and foreigners; haemophobia: abnormal fear of blood; claustrophobia: abnormal fear of confined or closed spaces.

questions.explanation: The word is "triskaidekaphobia": abnormal fear of the number thirteen. The other options mean: xenophobia: fear or hatred of strangers and foreigners; arachnophobia: abnormal fear of spiders; acrophobia: abnormal fear of heights.

questions.questionText: Select the single word that best substitutes for: "An abnormal fear of snakes"

questions.questionText: Which one word stands for "The scientific study of fish"?
questions.explanation: The word is "ichthyology": the scientific study of fish. The other options mean: ornithology: the scientific study of birds; herpetology: the scientific study of reptiles and amphibians; mycology: the scientific study of fungi.

questions.questionText: What is the one-word substitute for: "The scientific study of reptiles and amphibians"?
questions.explanation: The word is "herpetology": the scientific study of reptiles and amphibians. The other options mean: ichthyology: the scientific study of fish; ornithology: the scientific study of birds; mycology: the scientific study of fungi.

questions.questionText: Choose the one word that can replace the phrase: "The scientific study of earthquakes"
questions.explanation: The word is "seismology": the scientific study of earthquakes. The other options mean: meteorology: the scientific study of weather and the atmosphere; geology: the scientific study of the earth's rocks and structure; oceanography: the study of the oceans.

questions.explanation: The word is "meteorology": the scientific study of weather and the atmosphere. The other options mean: seismology: the scientific study of earthquakes; hydrology: the scientific study of water and its movement over and under the earth; astronomy: the scientific study of celestial bodies.

questions.questionText: Which one word stands for "The scientific study of fungi"?
questions.explanation: The word is "mycology": the scientific study of fungi. The other options mean: botany: the scientific study of plants; zoology: the scientific study of animals; ichthyology: the scientific study of fish.

questions.questionText: What is the one-word substitute for: "The study of family descent and lineage"?

questions.questionText: Choose the one word that can replace the phrase: "The branch of medicine that deals with the study and treatment of cancer"
questions.explanation: The word is "oncology": the study and treatment of cancer. The other options mean: cardiology: the study and treatment of heart diseases; pathology: the study of the causes and nature of diseases; neurology: the study of the nervous system.

questions.questionText: Select the single word that best substitutes for: "The study of the causes and nature of diseases"
questions.explanation: The word is "pathology": the study of the causes and nature of diseases. The other options mean: oncology: the study and treatment of cancer; physiology: the study of the normal functioning of living organisms; pharmacology: the study of drugs and their effects.

questions.questionText: Which one word stands for "The study of fossils and the life of ancient geological periods"?
questions.explanation: The word is "palaeontology": the study of fossils and the life of ancient geological periods. The other options mean: archaeology: the study of human history through excavated remains; geology: the scientific study of the earth's rocks and structure; anthropology: the study of human origins, societies and cultures.

questions.questionText: What is the one-word substitute for: "The study of how living things are related to one another and to their surroundings"?
